name: MongoDB MCP Server
summary: Official MCP server for querying and managing MongoDB databases and MongoDB Atlas clusters, with a read-only mode.
description: Runs locally via `npx mongodb-mcp-server` with a connection string (optionally `--readOnly`). For Atlas, MongoDB recommends its hosted Atlas MCP server over OAuth, installed as the `mongodb-atlas` plugin in Cursor, VS Code, Claude, Codex and GitHub Copilot CLI.
